Actions.Text: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND DRUG ABUSE

Title: Requires contractors with the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services maintain an operating reserve
Summary: Requires contractors with the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services maintain an operating reserve to be used to address financial issues that occur during a contract year.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, in relation to requiring contractors with the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services maintain an operating reserve
